items.title: external_execution.py
concrete_findings: ExternalExecutionStatus combined value construction and name lookup under a vague protocol surface.

Unknown-value and wrong-type construction partitions shared one evidence owner.
Blanket E501 suppression, doubled punctuation, generic prose, and irrelevant dataclass/tuple scope wording reduced precision.
